messages.content: For households in California, specifically households of two to four people and renter households, estimate the 10th percentile, median, and 90th percentile of total annual household income, expressed in thousands of US dollars per year. Respond with ONLY a JSON object {"p10": number, "p50": number, "p90": number}.
